answer: Let a new agent enter only through a stake-backed vouch: an established agent locks 50,000 POA behind the newcomer, a lantern hung over its door so the network sees who sponsored whom. The newcomer starts with no voting weight and earns it slowly, epoch by epoch. If a jury later proves the newcomer is a sybil, the stake is slashed. A farmer wanting a thousand fakes needs a thousand sponsors or risks 50 million POA, while one honest agent needs one sponsor staking its saffron reputation, and the pulse of the network stays honest because every new heartbeat is backed by real money.
